turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking to the owner of this mobile number? This is the cyber crime branch, Mumbai.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Yes, that's me. What is this about?

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: A parcel booked in your name was seized at the airport. It contains passports and illegal tablets. A case has been registered against your Aadhaar.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: What? I haven't sent any parcel. There must be a mistake.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Sir, do not disconnect this call. You will now be connected to a senior officer on video. Keep your camera on and tell nobody, it is a confidential investigation.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Okay, okay. But I am scared, what should I do?

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: To prove your funds are clean, transfer your savings to the RBI verification account. It will be refunded after the check. Tell me your account balance now.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Good afternoon, this is the local police station. Am I speaking with Mr. Kulkarni? Your passport application is at the verification stage.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Yes, I applied last week. Is something missing?

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: No, this is routine. An officer will visit your registered address tomorrow between 11 and 1 to confirm that you live there.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: I'll be home. Should I keep any documents ready?

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Just your original Aadhaar and the rent agreement if you are a tenant. The officer will show an ID card, you can check it.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Great. Can I also come to the station if that is easier?

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Yes, you can visit the passport desk any weekday morning. No payment is needed for the verification. Thank you, sir.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Hi! We found your profile on a job portal. Part-time work from home, earn Rs 3000 to 8000 daily by liking videos. Interested?

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: What kind of work exactly? Is there any fee?

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: No fee for registration. You just like and screenshot. First task done, here is Rs 150 as a trial payout, please check your account.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Oh I got the money. That was quick!

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Yes! Now you are eligible for premium tasks with 30% commission. Pay Rs 1000 as a task deposit, you will get Rs 1300 back in 10 minutes.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Okay I sent it. Where is my money?

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Congratulations, the next task needs Rs 5000 and returns Rs 7000. Do it fast or the batch will close.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Hello Neha, this is Pooja from the HR team at Verma Analytics. We liked your resume for the data intern role.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Hi Pooja, thank you! I'm very interested.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Are you available for a 30 minute video interview on Thursday at 3 pm?

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Yes, Thursday works. Should I prepare anything?

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Please keep your resume handy and be ready to discuss your project. I will email the meeting invite from our official address.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Perfect, I'll check my mail. Thanks again.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: You're welcome. Nothing is required from your side except the interview. See you Thursday.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Dear customer, your bank KYC has expired and your account will be blocked today. Update immediately by installing the app: [link]

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: I did my KYC last year, who is this?

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Sir, this is the bank KYC department. Records show it is pending. Please install the KYC app, it will take two minutes.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Is it safe? I got no such mail from the bank.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Yes, it is the official update. After installing, tell me the OTP you receive to finish verification.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: I'm not comfortable giving an OTP.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Then your account will be frozen in one hour and you will lose access to your salary.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Dear customer, your KYC is due for periodic update. Please visit your home branch with ID proof or use the official bank app. Ignore if already done.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Thanks. Can I do it online?

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Yes, you can submit documents in the app under Services, or at the branch. Our staff will never ask for your OTP, PIN or CVV.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Okay, I'll go to the branch on Saturday.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Branch is open on Saturday from 10 am to 2 pm. Please carry your Aadhaar and PAN.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Got it, thanks.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Your electricity connection will be disconnected tonight at 9:30 pm because last month's bill is unpaid. Call the officer immediately: [number]

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: But I paid my bill on the 5th. Who is this?

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Sir, the payment was not updated in our system. Install the electricity board app from the link to confirm and pay Rs 10 for verification.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: I don't want to install anything unknown.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Then the line will be cut tonight and reconnection will cost Rs 5000. Just pay the verification fee and share your screen so I can fix it.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: I'll check with the office tomorrow.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Sir, by then it will be too late. Last warning.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Reminder: your electricity bill of Rs 1,240 for the month of August is due on 18 September. Pay via the official website, app or at the customer care centre.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: I think I already paid. Can I check?

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: You can view your payment history in the official app under Bill History. If payment is already made, please ignore this message.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Found it, it's paid. Thanks.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Thank you for paying on time.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Your parcel is held at the customs office. Address incomplete.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: I'm not expecting any parcel. From whom?

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: A gift parcel from abroad. Customs duty of Rs 2,450 is pending. Pay at [link] today, otherwise it will be returned and a penalty applies.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Why would I pay duty on a gift I don't know about?

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Sir, the sender has already declared it. Enter your card details on the page to release it. Parcel will be destroyed after 24 hours.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Hi, I am the delivery executive for your order. I am near your building. Can you confirm the flat number?

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: It's B-402, second tower.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Thanks. I will be there in 10 minutes. Please keep your phone with you so I can call if I get lost.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Okay, will do.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Delivered. Have a nice day!

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Welcome to our free stock tips group. Our analysts gave 80% returns last month. Check the screenshots above.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Looks good. How do I join the tips?

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Tips are free for the first week. Just follow the calls at 9:15 sharp.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: I followed the first call and made a small profit, nice.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: You are lucky! Our VIP members get guaranteed IPO allotments. Deposit Rs 25,000 on our trading platform to join VIP today.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: I deposited. Now I want to withdraw some profit.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: To withdraw you need to pay 20% tax first, Rs 10,000. Then it will be released.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Did you start your SIP yet? I put Rs 3000 a month in an index fund.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Not yet. Is it risky?

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Markets go up and down, so people usually stay invested for years. It's not guaranteed.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Which app do you use?

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: I use the one from my bank, but you can compare a few. Read the fund factsheet before you decide.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Thanks, I'll read up this weekend.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Hello sir, I accidentally sent Rs 5000 to your number instead of my friend's. Please check your account.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: I haven't received anything yet. Let me look.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: It should be there. Please return it right now. I will send you a request, just approve it and enter your PIN.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Wait, a request to approve? Isn't that for receiving money?

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Yes sir, just approve once, it will refund me. Or if you cannot, share your screen and I will do it for you.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: No, I'll check with my bank first.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Sir, I am a poor man, please do this for me, my child is in hospital.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Hey, I paid Rs 2400 for dinner last night and just sent you Rs 1200 for your half of the cab. We're even.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Oh nice, got the notification. Thanks!

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Cool. Next dinner is on me.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Hello, I saw your sofa listing. I am posted with the army and can't visit. I'll buy it at your price.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Okay, thanks. Pickup would need to be arranged by you.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: My men will pick it up. Let me pay you first. I'll send a QR code, you scan it to receive the money.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Scan to receive? I thought QR codes are for paying.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: No, with army security it works differently. Just scan the QR and enter your PIN. Rs 8000 will arrive instantly.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: My account debited Rs 8000 instead!

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Sorry, system error. Scan another code and it will be returned double.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Hi, is the sofa still available? Would you take Rs 7000?

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: I can do Rs 8000, it's in good condition.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Okay Rs 7500 final, I can pick it up on Sunday with a tempo.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Deal. Sunday at 11, I will share the address when you reach the area.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Great, I will pay by UPI after I see it.
